subject: How can I use data selected with a click in a second plot

messages.author: 6fa59fff72a3c1e4
messages.subject: How can I use data selected with a click in a second plot
parts:
My question is commented in the server section below. 

Thank you.


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(Cairo)
mtcars2<-mtcars[,c('mpg','cyl','disp','hp','wt','am','gear')]

ui <- fluidPage(
  fluidRow(
    column(width = 12,class='well',
      h4('testing header'),
      fluidRow(
        column(width=6,
               plotOutput('plot1',height=300,
                          click='plot1_click'),
                          verbatimTextOutput('info')
                          ),
      column(width = 6,
             plotOutput('plot2',height=300)
      )
      )
    )
  )
)
   
            

server <- function(input, output) {

 output$info <- renderPrint({
          nearPoints(mtcars2, input$plot1_click)
  })

 output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
        ggplot(mtcars2, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point()
  })

####---Question.
####---How can I use the row of data selected in the nearPoints in the second plot.  The row from nearPoints but two different columns. 
####---
 output$plot2<- renderPlot({
    d<-data
    ggplot(mtcars2,aes(disp,hp)) + geom_point() + geom_point(aes(selected$disp,selected$hp,colour='red')
  })
 
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
